title: Separate a notification from the records behind it
communicates: Keep individual records visible while notification and collection counts change independently.

source.title: signal(7), queueing of standard signals
source.locator: Technical constraint for an authored visual pattern

observation: Repeated pending standard signals coalesce rather than forming a counted queue.
interpretation: Authored ledger pattern: one notice indicator beside several separately collectible records.
avoid: Do not equate one notification with one record.
Do not depict an exited child as executing code.
